note: Reference-document registry (D-15). Every cited document has a stable SRC id. Hashes identify a copy, they do not grant rights: rights stay unknown until reviewed. Cached copies live only under the gitignored refs/ directory and are never committed.

sources.title: GI CP-1600 Microprocessor Users Manual, May 1975
sources.note: Scanned image PDF (document code S16DOC-CP1600-04). Plan 01-02 verifies the cached copy against this digest. The manual describes the CP-1600; applying it to the CP-1610 is an inference. Electrical specifications in it are marked tentative.

sources.title: GI Microelectronics Data Catalog, 1980
sources.note: Hash and page readings recorded by the phase-1 research download (2026-11-09); research-era provenance, not re-read in this phase. The 8900 system section (STIC) was located at pdf 190-191 (printed 5-9 and 5-10) and the AY-3-8910 sound generator at pdf 204-209 during research. The text layer contains no 8914 entry. Phase 5 plan 05-01 (2026-11-12): fetched again into the gitignored cache and hash-verified (size and sha256 equal the values above); pdf 204-210 (printed 5-23..5-29, AY-3-8910/8912) re-read, see docs/psg/reference-notes.md.

sources.title: GI Microelectronics Data Catalog, 1982
sources.note: Hash and page readings recorded by the phase-1 research download (2026-11-09); research-era provenance, not re-read in this phase. Used as a second catalog edition for the CP1610 and STIC sections. Phase 5 plan 05-01 (2026-11-12): fetched again into the gitignored cache and hash-verified; pdf 299-305 carry the same AY-3-8910/8912/8913 text as the 1980 catalog (no closed-form frequency equations either).

sources.title: Blue Sky Rangers, Intellivision Model 2609 hardware overview
sources.note: Edited reproduction of an in-house technical document, per the page itself. Re-downloaded with a browser User-Agent on 2026-11-09 for this registry: the observed digest and size match the research-era values exactly (no difference). Web pages change, so the access date matters. The copy is held only in the gitignored cache.

sources.title: Intellivision community wiki (Hand Controller and timing pages)
sources.note: Community wiki; wiki pages are editable and change, so a hash of one revision would not identify the document. Research read revision 14808 of the Hand Controller page (last edited 2010). Consulted as a lead for active-low input behaviour and ambiguous key combinations; needs a cross-check against schematics, software or hardware. Phase 5 locators: Hand_Controller revision 14808 (page text; the page html differs byte for byte between fetches because the server inserts per-request tokens, size 14,861 bytes, so only the image hash identifies a copy) and the key-table image Hand_controller.png@oldid-14808 (image hash sha256 f789cc5a5954072374d958f1f96d1013a0de2c04b2510ee97b3129766bb41d36, 7,498 bytes, 283 x 443, re-fetched and re-hashed on 2026-11-12; read locally only, never committed); PSG.oldid-14940 (PSG page, last edited 2011-09-28, recorded by the Phase 5 discuss, not re-read in plan 05-01). Cached only under the gitignored refs/ directory.

sources.title: Community emulator documentation tree (programming notes on STIC, PSG, interrupts, memory map)
sources.note: GPL-licensed community documentation tree of a downstream emulator fork. Documentation read as a lead only; the emulator source is never opened for implementation and no copy is kept in the workspace. Not hashed because it is a moving directory tree, not a single document. Research-era licence reads are disclosed in docs/provenance/CONSULTATIONS.md by plan 01-07.

sources.title: MAME Intellivision driver source files (src/mame/mattel and the CP1610 core)
sources.note: Hints only; never an oracle; not hashed because it is consulted as a lead, not cited for values. Clock lines and per-file licence headers (BSD-3-Clause) were read during phase-1 research. No code, tables, comments or structure are copied.

sources.title: Mattel Intellivision owner manual (bootstrap source, corrected entry)
sources.note: Bootstrap source defect: the bootstrap URL returns 404 (redirects land on a generic category page). A candidate copy on another host answered with a PDF content type but was located and not opened, so nothing is read from it. User-facing input description only, not an electrical source. Rights unknown; not hashed because no verified copy was obtained.

sources.title: Intellivision Model 2609 service manual scan on iFixit (bootstrap source, corrected entry)
sources.note: Bootstrap source defect: the URL serves an HTML viewer page, not a PDF. Page metadata states 21 pages and subassembly-level diagnostics. The viewer content was not read, so the bootstrap claims about the MTE-201 test cartridge and a 90-minute burn-in are unverified. Third-party host; rights unknown; not hashed because only an HTML viewer was available.

sources.title: GI AY-3-8910/8912 Programmable Sound Generator Data Manual (third-party reprint copy)
sources.note: Edited reproduction by the project's own definition (docs/evidence-tiers.md): a third-party reprint whose cover adds notes and omits pages. The Phase 5 discuss recorded a copy of 55 pages with sha256 3fbc9b40c7736ab79270e274bb6688f2d9f0dab693d7eb8060d6d8d29cd73deb, hosted on a public file CDN whose address was not recorded. Plan 05-01 could not obtain that copy: the url field names the 1980 catalog that prints the same register text and figures, the capture is reference-only and no hash is pinned here. Only a different 8-page scan (not this document) was reachable. Every PSG fact in the project is therefore cited to the catalog pages (pdf 204-210), and anything that only this reprint prints (closed-form frequency equations, period ranges, the worked envelope example, the DAC voltage labels, the amplitude mode bit sense) is recorded as not re-read.

sources.title: Intellivision Controller Pinouts (J. Tilton, 06/28/98), web-archive capture of a 2006 page
sources.note: Community pin chart of the hand controller. The Phase 5 discuss recorded a capture of 10,837 bytes with sha256 prefix c93d5014 (same lineage as SRC-consolemods-intv-pinouts). Plan 05-01 could not re-fetch it (exact archive address not recorded, archive search denied), so no hash is pinned here and the controller literal cites it nowhere; rows cite the re-read sources only.

sources.title: ConsoleMods wiki, Intellivision:Connector Pinouts, revision 23186 (web-archive capture)
sources.note: Community wiki page with the controller-port pin table, the pin-to-PSG-bit map and the 31-row pull-to-ground matrix. Identity is the revision number (23186, read on 2026-11-12). The capture bytes are not pinned: the Phase 5 discuss recorded 36,791 bytes with sha256 prefix 984d548c, plan 05-01 fetched 35,364 bytes with sha256 prefix 82ad0ff1 (the archive wraps each fetch in a different toolbar), so no hash is pinned and the difference is recorded, not accepted as a match. The live host answers 403 to command-line clients. Cached only under refs/.
